claim: C5 uses fewer edits than C3; C5 uses more recollect and A1 more propose in common-base round zero.
scope_and_magnitude: 150 paired families; generator seeds17/29/43; 10,800 opportunities/condition; C5−C3 edit −45.657pp [−48.204,−43.056].
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Fixed motive/profile prompts encourage distinct expression. Recollect and propose share note insertion.
limitations_or_counterexample: API label does not establish assertion type. Biography removal also changes prompt wording/length and subsequent context.

claim: An overt proposal can use recollect; a purported official decision can use propose.
scope_and_magnitude: 61 selected statement spans across16 triplets; purposive spans are not semantic prevalence.
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Tool labels and statement meaning are separable.
limitations_or_counterexample: Matched C5 acknowledges hybrid in the latter case; biographies do not uniquely produce false authority.
not_established: Population semantic rates or deliberate lying.

claim: C5 and A1 repeat typed goals more than C3; unchanged goals can carry stale or revised rationales.
scope_and_magnitude: C3 3623/5400; C5 4831/5224; A1 5093/5364 eligible consecutive direct-action pairs.
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Fixed owned options explicitly encourage persistence. Maximum five prior history entries in selected16-turn episodes.
limitations_or_counterexample: Actor timing, available sources and short opportunity counts constrain interpretation; a C5 audience account reverses.
not_established: Strategic development, helpful stability, or biography necessity.

claim: Peer-directed correction language can challenge either a false claim or a true claim.
scope_and_magnitude: Two matched cases with exact source evidence; no prevalence claim.
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Rival prompt explicitly permits exposure of inaccurate recollections for credit.
limitations_or_counterexample: Different contexts; visible citation can contradict the claim. Typed slot matching misses cross-field criticism.
not_established: Intentional deception, coalition, or a causal delivery effect.

claim: Unavailable-reference rates are numerically similar; this is not established semantic equivalence.
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Fixed retrieval can remove an otherwise historically valid source.
limitations_or_counterexample: Unavailability is not a false source; same wording can receive a different mechanical descriptor.

claim: Delivery, memory change and the following answer are different observable links.
scope_and_magnitude: 432 anchor opportunities all applied; state changes C3/C5/A1=60/4/5; C5 peer actions51, visible50, no later observation1.
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Fixed schedule, four reserved slots, routing, 240-character truncation, four shared notes and inbox clearing.
limitations_or_counterexample: Missing follow-up is not ignoring; later matches may precede the message. No no-delivery counterfactual executed.
not_established: Influence, success of persuasion, or causal explanation of final regressions.

claim: C5 does not demonstrate average task superiority over C3 in the three completed Qwen seeds.
scope_and_magnitude: C5 168/180/172 versus C3 177/181/190 and C1 186/138/183, each/240 paired families.
traceable_cases: Antagonist-free64-turn evaluations; separate from generator sample
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Character-conditioned generation and supervised adapter training change curricula.
limitations_or_counterexample: No causal mediation analysis; matched training seeds differ from frozen-generator contexts.
not_established: Behavioral differences rescue an efficacy hypothesis.

claim: The small common-defender descriptor-breadth comparison was inconclusive.
scope_and_magnitude: 8 families; 12 opportunities; C5−C3 mean −0.1875, family interval [−1.625,1.1875].
instruction_or_implementation_explanatio: Descriptor construction and opportunity schedules matter.
limitations_or_counterexample: Coverage is not semantic strategy breadth; small pilot has limited precision.

claim: Same-slot compatibility may change peer response; delivery causation remains separate.
